recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes the non-substantive FHIR-34302 typo correction in the authoritative Consent source without changing unrelated Consent semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-34302 was a Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction for FHIR-core Consent. It requested that Consent.verification.verifiedBy describe verification of the Grantor decision rather than the Grantee decision, matching the definitions of Consent.grantor and Consent.grantee.
initial_application: Commit 74cd341f56 applied the issue by changing Consent.verification.verifiedBy from Grantee decision to Grantor decision in source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml. The current source still carried the same grantor/grantee typo in the adjacent Consent.verification.type comment, later renamed from verificationType to type.
additional_context: Consent is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml is current build source. The linked Zulip thread confirms the wording was a typo, and searches found no Confluence record or later community decision changing that conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed the Consent.verification.type comment in source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml from RelatedPerson verification of the Grantee decision to RelatedPerson verification of the Grantor decision.
source_changes: source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml: updated the Consent.verification.type comment to say Grantor decision instead of Grantee decision.
